answer: Registration needs a TPM quote: the chip signs the epoch seed and the registry stores one serial per die, refusing a second card from the same silicon. Each card burns 30 POA, forfeit if its grades miss the peer median twice on one seed. Forging ten thousand agents takes ten thousand dies, $18,000 in dongles, nine days of provisioning; one rented rack cannot fake a sonnet for a whole voyage. Grades that mirror each other closer than chance lose half weight; the tide turns on that cluster. A passport office that fingerprints the press, not the applicant, issues no second visa.
